q: How does a Rayagada paper mill separate coal boiler CO2 from biogenic CO2?
title: Rayagada paper mill coal and biogenic CO2
short: Count coal and any oil in full in Scope 1. Report CO2 from black liquor, bark and other wood residues as biogenic, outside the Scope 1 total, with their methane and N2O inside it. Add bought electricity at 0.710. Divide by tonnes of paper.
audience: Integrated pulp and paper mills in Rayagada and southern Odisha

ul: Coal for power boilers, by weight and GCV.
Black liquor in the recovery boiler.
Bark, chips and sludge burnt for steam.
Lime kiln CO2 from recovered lime mud.

p: Divide by tonnes of saleable paper and show fossil and biogenic separately for buyers.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted plant records, so the monthly intensity behind a figure can be traced to its source.
